title: Spammy User Entry Care portal (CGM Sensor insert)
symptom: The user entry tab in the Treatments section logs the same message every 5 minutes, creating a spam list that grows over time.
cause: The issue is related to using xDrip+ as a collector with Dexcom G7, causing repeated CGM sensor insert entries.
fix: A fix was merged into the dev branch (commit ce20cccf) that resolves the spam issue. Users experiencing the problem with xDrip+ and G7 were asked to test pull request #3804, which fixed the issue for the reporter.
evidence_quote: If using xDrip+ and G7 and experiencing this problem, please see https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3804 and test if you want. It fixed the issue for me.
